documents.title: Privacy notice
documents.status: This version becomes effective on approved publication. Phone verification, public registration and paid features remain subject to their separate release controls.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: Docked is operated by Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd, ABN 78 606 187 106. Contact support@docked.com.au about privacy, access, correction, deletion or a complaint.

sections.title: Account and gameplay information
sections.text:
We handle account identifiers, email, profile information, eligibility attestations, country/state, consent records, sessions and security information to operate and protect your account. Optional community posts, images, comments, reactions and follows are handled according to their audience, privacy and moderation settings. Do not send passwords, verification codes, payment-card details or identity documents to support.

We record packs, cards, serials, ownership, credits, purchases, refunds, fantasy entries and results to deliver the service, prevent duplicate fulfilment and resolve disputes. A historical shared-card snapshot can remain a record of the original post after the card changes owner; it is not proof of current ownership.

sections.title: Phone verification and processing
sections.text:
For public Australian account use, we require verification of an Australian mobile number. We use the number to establish control of that number, link one verified number to one Docked account, and reduce duplicate accounts and abuse. This does not establish that a person owns only one number or prove Australian residency. Your number is not displayed on your profile. Docked does not use verification numbers for marketing or sell them.

Supabase Auth stores the account's phone number, verification status and related authentication information. Twilio receives the destination number and verification message to deliver it through telecommunications providers. Verification messages contain a short-lived code. Enter the code only in Docked; do not give it to support or another person. Docked does not request access to your contacts or SMS inbox for verification. Twilio also processes delivery records and communications metadata for its own service operations, security, abuse prevention, service improvement and legal obligations under its published terms.

sections.title: Existing users and account recovery
sections.text: Existing accounts retain their identities and card ownership. Where public account features require phone verification, existing users must complete it too. A phone number does not replace your password, verified email or an enrolled authenticator. If your number is lost, changed or reassigned, contact support@docked.com.au. We use account-authentication and ownership checks before assisting recovery; possession of a reassigned number alone does not authorise transfer of another account, cards or credits. Account-deletion requests remain available without completing phone verification.

sections.title: Social content and support
sections.text:
Posts, comments, reactions, follows, community memberships, optional images and shared-card snapshots are processed to provide the social features. Visibility follows audience, privacy, blocking and moderation controls. Other members may copy content you share. A historical card-post snapshot can remain a record of what was shared after a transfer. Reports, internal moderation notes, private preferences and authentication records are not ordinary public posts.

Support receives the messages and information you provide. Do not email passwords, payment-card details, verification links or identity documents. Real identity-document collection is disabled in the current test release.

sections.title: Purchases
sections.text:
Until commercial launch approval, real-money purchasing remains disabled and only authorised Google Play TEST checkout is available. When approved purchasing is enabled, Google handles checkout and payment methods. Docked's server verifies purchase references, product, bound account, purchase state, fulfilment and refund evidence. Docked does not receive a complete Google payment-card number. Purchase references are sensitive and are not public profile data. Google processes information under its own privacy terms. Paid purchasing remains subject to the payment and commercial approval process. This notice does not activate purchases.

Google processes Android checkout and payment-method details. Docked verifies purchase references, product/order identifiers, account binding, region, amounts, purchase status and refunds on its server. We do not receive your full payment-card number from this integration. Purchase tokens are encrypted server-side and are not stored in browser storage or sent as analytics events. Google notifications trigger verification rather than directly changing balances.

sections.title: Service providers and overseas processing
sections.text:
Docked uses Supabase for authentication/database services, Vercel for hosting, Twilio for verification SMS and configured account/support email providers. Supabase's selected database region is Australia; providers may process information outside Australia, including in the United States and Singapore for delivery, operations or support. The current Twilio messaging service uses its United States region. Australian database hosting does not mean every provider processes information only in Australia. Provider and telecommunications processing is subject to their applicable privacy terms and legal obligations. Disclosure to authorised staff, advisers or authorities is limited to service, security, dispute or legal purposes.

Our support/account mailbox uses Microsoft Exchange Online, purchased through GoDaddy with its listed email security service. We have not verified the mailbox's data-at-rest geography or every provider recovery, quarantine, backup or hold setting. We do not promise Australian-only processing or a fixed date when every provider-held copy is erased.

sections.title: Device information and analytics
sections.text:
Network and security operations can involve IP addresses, device/request information and service logs. Optional first-party usage events require analytics consent and respect the browser's Do Not Track setting. Anonymous visitors are not assigned an identity by that observer. This does not mean hosting providers collect no operational information.

The app has no advertising SDK. Android and Google Play may provide operating-system diagnostics under their own settings.

The Android app also includes Google Play Billing Library. When the library is initialised or used, it sends billing-operation results, technical app/device information and a per-session identifier to Google for billing reliability, performance improvement and error support. This automatic SDK processing can occur without a completed purchase. It is separate from Docked's optional usage analytics and is not disabled by that analytics preference. Google handles this information under its own privacy terms.

Optional media selection and notification preferences follow device permissions and application controls. Contacts, microphone and location access are not required to buy a pack. We do not use identity documents or purchase tokens in Docked's optional usage analytics.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: The app uses HTTPS for communications with its servers. Access restrictions, rate limits, verification checks and privileged-account MFA help protect information. Ordinary SMS is not end-to-end encrypted. Optional first-party analytics follows consent and the application's privacy controls; security logs are separate. Media selection is user initiated. Buying a pack does not require contacts, microphone or precise-location access. Identity-document collection is not part of this no-withdrawal launch.

sections.title: Phone and verification-message retention
sections.text: We retain the current account phone number while it is needed for account verification and security. Account deletion removes active account identifying information through the account-erasure process; necessary restricted evidence may remain for financial, security, dispute or legal purposes. Verification-message records are separate from the active account record. Twilio's published default makes message records available for 400 days and can retain older records in archives until deletion is requested or configured. After a message is deleted, Twilio says its body may remain in backups for up to 30 days. Telecommunications records and data held for independent legal or security purposes can have different retention periods. A code expiring does not delete the message or its delivery record. No automatic 90-day deletion of phone or SMS records is promised.

sections.title: Access, correction and account deletion
sections.text:
Request an account export or deletion through Account settings. The account-deletion page is accessible on the web without installing the app. If you cannot sign in, use account recovery or contact support. We verify requests proportionately and do not routinely ask for identity documents.

Deletion first revokes access and sessions. In the current private beta, shared authentication identities require operator review before identity erasure; access revocation alone is not completed deletion. Eligible personal content is removed or pseudonymised through the deletion workflow. A failed or deferred step remains pending. Necessary ownership, competition, consent, dispute and security evidence can be retained for its documented purpose. Still-linkable information is not anonymous. Our retention notice explains the current targets and limitations.

For public customer accounts, credential erasure removes sign-in secrets and identifying Auth metadata while an opaque account reference may remain linked to necessary ownership, competition and audit records. The active profile is removed. This reference is restricted, is not an active login and is not described as anonymous while still linkable.

Use Account settings to request an export or deletion, or https://docked.com.au/account-deletion for a web request. If you cannot sign in, use account recovery or contact support. Authentication and proportionate checks protect these requests. Tell support if your request includes verification-message records so relevant provider-held records can be assessed and requests coordinated. We explain records that must be retained and why. A pending request is not represented as completed.

sections.title: Financial records and ownership provenance
sections.text: Company financial records are retained for at least seven years where required by Australian company law. This does not apply automatically to every profile detail, image, phone number or purchase token. Necessary minimal card serial and ownership provenance can remain after account deletion to protect other owners and permanent supply. Still-linkable account references are pseudonymous, not anonymous. Documented legal holds can extend the relevant period. Backups can retain information until expiry; recovery controls must honour completed deletion requests before restored information is returned to use.

sections.title: Questions and complaints
sections.text: Contact support to request access or correction or raise a complaint. We will explain applicable restrictions and review options. This notice does not exclude non-excludable privacy or consumer rights. Privacy complaint information is available from the OAIC at https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-complaints. Previous accepted policy versions remain recorded; publication does not rewrite a past consent.

documents.title: Purchases and refunds
documents.status: Owner-approved commercial model, prepared for release. Real-money purchases remain disabled pending external and technical release checks.

sections.title: Current availability
sections.text: Docked currently uses test credits and isolated test inventory. These are not cash and cannot be withdrawn. Google Play licence-test orders are not evidence of a real-money purchase. Public paid purchasing, withdrawals, paid competition entry and prize awards remain disabled.

sections.title: Approved paid-release products
sections.text:
The approved Google Play credit packages are A$49 for 4,900 Docked Credits and A$99 for 9,900, with no bonus credits. Google checkout must display the current price before confirmation. Credits are intended to be used in the shared wallet for sport-specific packs. No direct Australian-dollar pack prices are approved.

Standard packs: 1 card for 100 credits; 3 for 300; 9 for 700. Premium packs: 1 card for 700 credits; 3 for 1,900; 9 for 5,000. Review the exact product, card count, eligible rarities, displayed chances and final price before confirming. Packs contain random digital cards; a particular player, rarity or financial return is not guaranteed. Core is excluded from paid packs. Premium draws only Ultra Rare, Legendary and Icon. These product descriptions do not activate sales.

sections.title: Requesting help or a refund
sections.text: For a Google Play purchase issue, contact support@docked.com.au and use Google Play's purchase-support options. Include an order reference if available; do not send passwords or full payment details. Refunds and remedies remain subject to applicable consumer rights. Opening a pack does not by itself remove rights that cannot be excluded. We do not impose a blanket no-refunds rule.

sections.title: Payment and refund safety
sections.text:
A pending or declined purchase does not provide spendable credits. The server verifies purchase state and the associated member before fulfilment. Repeated requests must not credit a purchase twice.

When Google confirms a refund or revocation, Docked reverses the remaining credits from that purchase once. If credits have already been spent, the account can enter a recovery hold: affected spending or transfers may be restricted while support reviews the purchase, spending and refund records. Your history remains available. A hold is not an automatic bank charge, a negative spendable balance, debt collection or permission to take another member's cards. It does not remove consumer-law remedies.

Contact support@docked.com.au to dispute a hold, correct a mistaken account association or provide relevant refund evidence. Support must verify the purchase and record the reason for any resolution. No automatic charge or unrelated-card clawback is authorised by this policy. TEST orders and commercial purchases remain separate.

sections.title: Release and consumer safeguards
sections.text: The owner has approved this commercial model and the disclosed recovery-hold approach. That approval does not establish player/data rights, legal clearance or Google Play approval. Sales remain disabled until those requirements, the final customer purchase flow and operational support procedures are verified. Unopened packs, completed openings and later card transfers must be reviewed under the actual purchase evidence and applicable consumer law; there is no blanket forfeiture or no-refund rule. Beta credits and cards do not silently become money or permanent commercial inventory.

documents.title: Retention and deletion
documents.status: Current service targets and prepared commercial retention controls. Automated billing minimisation is disabled until separately configured and verified.

sections.title: Existing handling targets
sections.text: The existing beta policy targets removal of eligible account/contact details and posts/media within 30 days of verified closure. Access is revoked first. Account-to-game identity links are targeted for removal within 30 days after relevant rounds or disputes close. Minimized ownership/scoring evidence is reviewed at beta end and deleted or further de-identified within 12 months of beta closure unless a documented exception remains. These are handling targets, not a claim that every provider automatically erases every copy by that date.

sections.title: Operational and support records
sections.text: Existing targets are removal of routine support cases from the active mailbox 12 months after closure, and exported working copies after delivery verification within seven days. Routine operational logs have a maximum target of 30 days and security logs 90 days. Exceptional incident/dispute evidence requires a recorded reason and review at least every 90 days. These targets apply to records Docked controls; individual provider settings and legal holds must be checked.

sections.title: Exceptions, backups and pending deletion
sections.text:
Ongoing competitions, disputes, documented incidents or applicable obligations may require limited records for longer. Record the reason and review date and limit access. Permanent supply and scoring integrity do not justify retaining names or email addresses indefinitely. Still-linkable records are not anonymous.

Recovery, quarantine, backups and holds can preserve copies after active deletion. Relevant restrictions need review for each request. Completed deletion requests must be reapplied before restored data returns to active use. The current shared beta identity requires operator review for identity erasure. Failed erasure steps remain pending rather than being reported complete.

sections.title: Public commercial release
sections.text:
Financial records required by Australian company law must be kept for at least seven years after the transactions covered are completed. This does not require every profile field, document or routine log to be kept for seven years. Records subject to an active dispute, recovery case or legal hold remain restricted and under review; expiry of a review date does not automatically release a hold.

The prepared billing worker minimizes completed notification/retry records after 90 days, with an encrypted recovery archive for a further 30 days. Minimal notification identifiers remain to reject replay. It does not delete financial journals, ownership history or purchase verification references. The worker is not yet active. Purchase references are access-restricted for verification, refund/replay prevention and dispute handling; the final deletion point must be documented against the applicable provider and legal requirements before automated erasure. These records are not described as anonymous while still linkable.

Retention controls do not erase all provider backups or mailbox copies. Contact support@docked.com.au for the records and reasons applicable to your deletion request. We will not call a pending or held step complete.

documents.title: Service and commercial release policy
documents.status: Owner-approved commercial model; public release, live payments and third-party rights remain gated.

sections.title: Service scope
sections.text: Docked offers NFL, AFL and NRL fantasy cards through one account. The current service is an invitation-only Australian adult test beta. Public registration is closed. Withdrawals, real-money purchases, paid competition entry and prize awards are disabled. Test credits and inventory have no cash value. NBA remains unavailable.

sections.title: Gameplay and collections
sections.text: Teams, positions, salary caps, multipliers, lockout and scoring follow the selected competition's saved rules. Fantasy salaries are not wallet credits. Scoring is postgame or as available, not guaranteed live play-by-play. A purchase does not guarantee a win. The prepared free Core eligibility path creates no collectible ownership and remains controlled by competition eligibility and activation. Public free-play onboarding must be verified before registration opens.

sections.title: Packs and marketplace
sections.text:
Standard and Premium packs are part of the owner-approved commercial model, subject to the purchase and refund policy and activation requirements. Card supply, serials, probabilities and ownership protections are not changed by these documents.

The marketplace supports credit sales only; offers and swaps are disabled. A 5% selling fee is deducted when your card sells, capped at 2,000 credits per sale. There's no minimum fee. Buyers pay the listed price. Fees are rounded to the nearest whole credit; half a credit rounds up. Sell a card for 1,000 credits: the fee is 50 and you receive 950. Existing historical fees are preserved. Commercial resale using purchased funds remains switched off until transfer, fraud, recovery and platform requirements are verified. Docked does not currently offer credit cash-out, peer-to-peer cash transfers or export of cards outside the service. A Docked card is a digital entitlement within the service, not ownership of a player, trademark or copyright, and no resale or financial return is promised.

sections.title: Account and community rules
sections.text: Use your own account, accurate eligibility information and the normal confirmation/security procedures. Do not evade access restrictions, impersonate others, exploit purchases or harass members. Existing reporting, blocking and moderation controls apply. No new privacy consent or previously accepted policy is silently replaced by this publication.

sections.title: Remaining release requirements
sections.text: The commercial-model decisions and use of verified professional player names are owner-confirmed. Separate rights for proprietary statistics, photographs, logos, distinctive protected artwork or endorsement claims are not implied by that confirmation. Remaining release requirements concern the applicable sources/materials, legal and Google Play assessment of paid cards, multipliers and credit resale, final customer acceptance, approved retention operations and the final release configuration. Withdrawals, paid competition entry and prizes remain disabled. These documents do not claim independent legal review, a provider licence or Google approval.
